name: model/publish
description: Publish a forged model to HuggingFace — safetensors, config, tokenizer, model card, and alloy provenance. This is the Factory's shipping department: the forge produces the artifact on a grid node, this command pushes it to HuggingFace where anyone can download it. Supports publishing from a local forged directory (bigmama-style) or from a grid node's finished/ station via grid/send.

params.name: forgedDir
params.description: Path to the forged model directory containing safetensors, config.json, tokenizer files, and optionally the .alloy.json recipe

params.name: repoName
params.description: HuggingFace repo name (e.g., 'mixtral-8x7b-instruct-compacted-conservative'). Published under the org.

params.name: cardPath
params.description: Path to a custom README.md model card. If omitted, a card is auto-generated from the alloy's results + metadata.

params.name: alloyPath
params.description: Path to the .alloy.json recipe file. If omitted, searches forgedDir for *.alloy.json. Included in the published repo as provenance.

params.name: includeGguf
params.description: Include GGUF quantized files if present in the forged dir (default: true)

params.name: evalPending
params.description: Mark the model card as 'eval in progress' with placeholder benchmark fields. Use when publishing before eval completes. Card will be updated via model/update-card when eval finishes.

params.name: nodeId
params.description: If forgedDir is on a remote grid node, specify the node ID. The command will use grid/send to execute the publish on the remote node.

params.name: tags
params.description: Additional HuggingFace tags beyond the auto-generated ones

results.name: totalSizeGb
results.description: Total size of uploaded files in GB

results.name: cardIncluded
results.description: Whether a model card was included

results.name: alloyIncluded
results.description: Whether the alloy recipe was included
